Clippy is part of 1 of my public repositories, from 2018 to 2018.

What it was for: [Science and visualisation](@/projects/science.md) (1).

Most recently: [rustas](@/work/rustas.md): Rust - Assembler, Mathematics, GPU and many others.

How to read the evidence: every [repository](@/glossary/repository.md) below is measured from GitHub and GitLab (every 6 hours) and says how it uses Clippy: as the main language, as a measured share of its code, in its declared stack or as a topic. The reference graph links Clippy to the repositories and to the other languages and technologies they use together.
